name: Sofia Vargas Mendoza
bio:
Sofia Vargas Mendoza’s path to motorsport security was unconventional. After a career in the Peruvian National Police, specializing in anti-terrorism and high-risk situations, Sofia sought a new challenge. A chance encounter with a Birel ART team member during a security consultation for a Lima-based karting event sparked her interest. Impressed by her sharp instincts and meticulous approach, the team offered her a role as security chief. 

Sofia's approach to security is proactive and detail-oriented. She believes in rigorous risk assessment, preventative measures, and building strong relationships with team members to foster a culture of safety and vigilance. What sets Sofia apart is her blend of law enforcement expertise with an understanding of the unique demands of motorsport, ensuring the team's assets and personnel are always protected. Her experience in handling high-pressure situations makes her uniquely qualified to handle any unforeseen challenges.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, neatly tied back in a practical bun.
physical.description: A stern but fair woman with a commanding presence, Sofia's sharp eyes miss nothing.

quirks: Always carries a small, well-worn copy of the Peruvian Constitution.
Has a habit of tapping her pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Insists on a daily team security briefing, no matter how short.
